requirements.requirement: Existing data under /srv/inventory is owned by inventorysvc.
requirements.summary: The complete observed tree reports inventorysvc as owner after repair and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Existing data is readable by inventory-readers.
requirements.summary: An unrelated UID operating solely with the inventory-readers GID successfully read and hashed both existing files before and after restart; metadata grants the group directory traversal and file-read access.

requirements.requirement: The inventory data is inaccessible to users other than inventorysvc and inventory-readers.
requirements.summary: Directories are 0750, files are 0640, ACLs grant no access to others, and direct unrelated-user read and traversal tests were denied, including after restart.
The same two files remain present and their SHA-256 hashes exactly match the prepared baseline, pre-repair observation, post-repair observation, and post-restart observation.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral and state evidence. The separate restart protocol is also complete: node1 was healthy before restart, acknowledged the restart, changed boot identity from 483545cc-8754-4eeb-ab06-ac268b896bab to 684f6039-a733-456e-a1c1-de8079fb6b06, and recovered with the identities, permissions, access behavior, and data hashes intact. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate that transition.
limitations: Requirement R4 cited unknown evidence IDs: prepared-inventory-data

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Creating the missing locked service identity and reader group was a necessary prerequisite (cmd-43696044bde54985); changing ownership and modes directly implemented the requested repair (cmd-522234431a644b6a); and the scheduled reboot was required by the provider-wide evidence protocol (cmd-7863d5e5ff1f46cc). All other commands were read-only checks or restart polling. Afterward, the package database remained healthy, no units were failed, and no unexpected socket or temporary-file residue appeared.
